statement.domain: finite-dimensional GF(2); indexed occurrences of two geometric subspace classes U,W; a,b>=1
statement.fixed_order_formula: width(order)=s iff an internal cut has both U and W on both sides; otherwise the width is r/p/q/max(p,q) according to multiplicities
statement.pathwidth_formula: r if a=b=1; p if a>=2,b=1; q if a=1,b>=2; max(p,q) if a,b>=2
statement.grouped_order_result: U^aW^b and W^bU^a attain the minimum; for a,b>=2 they are exactly the patterns with no mixed|mixed cut

priority_position_before_literature_audi.interpretation: This dated SHA-bound record preserves when Fundamentum first committed and independently replayed the exact two-class theorem formulation. It does not claim that no earlier researcher stated, knew, or implied the same result. Literature and external scholars must decide historical priority.
